name: hcportal_getKennel
description: Returns one kennel's full profile for the portal's kennel editor and the HashRuns.org service account: identity, location (city/region/country with flags), website settings, dissemination flags, default run settings, membership settings, three payment-scheme slots, bank details, card payment provider, runs-page import status, trail symbol/type config and notification windows. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicKennelId as the context identifier. There is no kennel permission gate: any authenticated portal caller (regular user callerType 0, or service account 1/2) can read any kennel. Read-only. Permission (2026-10-13): HC6.nonApi_portalKennelAccess — AppAccessFlags 0x4000008B (SuperAdmin, Admin, Manage kennel 0x2, Manage hash cash 0x8, 0x80), manageKennelSettings, or platform CanEditKennel; otherwise {Success 0, 'Not authorised to manage this kennel'}. Idempotency: read-only — the nonApi_portalKennelAccess EXEC is a permission check that writes nothing.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth. @publicKennelId is passed as the paramString.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The public kennel ID to retrieve. Validated IS NULL after auth. Kennel must exist or an error is returned.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned alone on auth failure, 'Hasher not found', 'Null or invalid publicKennelId', 'Kennel not found', or from the CATCH (ERROR_MESSAGE(), not logged).

columns.name: Success
columns.description: Always 0 on error

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Human-readable error message

rowsets.name: KennelDetailResult
rowsets.description: On success: exactly one row (empty if the kennel's city/region/country chain is broken — INNER JOINs). Columns in SELECT order.
